description: A Python script implementing a Streamlit-based chatbot interface that interacts with a SQL database using LangChain and OpenAI models. It sets up database connections, defines tools, and manages user interactions for database querying and conversational responses.

methods.name: greeting_input
methods.description: Returns a greeting response based on user input.

methods.name: count_tokens
methods.description: Runs a prompt through the language model to count tokens and process user queries.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that runs the Streamlit app, handling user input and chatbot responses.
